en: The White Dagoba of 北海

facts.zh: 白塔是一六五一年建的。
facts.en: The White Dagoba was built in 1651.
facts.how: Read the sign by the White Dagoba.

facts.en: It stands on an island in the middle of the lake.
facts.how: Read the sign at the boat pier.

facts.zh: 北海很老，八百多年以前就有了。
facts.en: 北海 is China's oldest imperial garden, begun more than 800 years ago.
facts.how: Read the park's sign on the north shore.

en: Jingshan, the hill behind the palace

facts.zh: 景山上有五个亭子，中间的万春亭最高。
facts.en: Five pavilions line the ridge; 万春亭 in the middle is the highest.
facts.how: Read the sign at 万春亭.

facts.zh: 故宫是明朝建的，不是秦始皇。
facts.en: The palace was built under the Ming, not by 秦始皇.
facts.how: Help 甜甜 get her history right.

en: The corner tower and the fox

facts.zh: 狐狸走在前面，老虎走在后面，动物们怕的是老虎。
facts.en: The fox walks in front, the tiger behind — and the animals run from the tiger.

facts.zh: 这个故事，中国小学生都学。
facts.en: Every Chinese primary school pupil learns this story.
